isolation.homes: Independent temporary HOME/AW/Agent/XDG roots and project/neutral directories per scope.
isolation.clientInstallation: Exact public npm versions; installation scripts disabled; temporary prefixes removed.

extraction.outputs: Checks, bounded stdout and per-command processManagement are copied from the redacted source report. Native stderr is omitted. No response body or result is invented.
extraction.paths: Original report placeholders <TEMP_ROOT>/<CLIENT_BIN>/<HOST_HOME> are retained. Entry digests identify only the recorded entry file; package integrity and lock digests remain separate.

qualificationBoundary.products: Only Claude CLI 2.1.317 User and Project ordinary Skills in Linux, macOS and Windows x64/arm64. App and other versions or hosts are excluded.
qualificationBoundary.surface: Native marketplace registration, installation, version update, removal, component inventory and effective scope activation inventory from the AW projection candidate.
qualificationBoundary.acceptanceCriterion: Native management and fresh effective activation queries establish the accepted ordinary plugin management and scope boundary. Skill discovery and loading are unknown and non-blocking under the user direction accepted on 2026-11-13.
limitations: Component inventory is not real Skill discovery, Skill loading, model adoption or execution evidence.
No prompts, model requests, Skill invocation controls, tool restriction, MCP, Hook, Agent or Instructions execution qualification.

Fresh plugin list --json queries show User enabled in both project and neutral working directories. Project installs use local scope: enabled=true in the target project and enabled=false in neutral; projectPath identifies the fixture project.
Only the twelve passed Native scope cells qualify. All six original reports and all twelve Claude public AW cells remain unverified; no original report is changed or reclassified.
Public AW adapter end-to-end acceptance requires a new real report and is separate from this record.
Process receipts support only the recorded management and effective activation qualification, not other Provider, OS or profile capabilities.
No extrapolation to App, another version, OS, architecture, component or feature.
